reason: The sachets are handy for my travel days, but $29.99 is more than what I pay for Toplux or Goli, and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. Even at $24.99 I would rather finish what I have first.
objection: It costs more than the brands I already know and I have no proof yet that it works better for me than the cheaper bottle.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19 to $20 a box for the regular price, or a small trial pack so I can try a few nights before committing to 30.
